title: EVPN RT Community Mismatch — dc2-leaf1a TENANT-A stops importing routes
symptom: EVPN BGP sessions on dc2-leaf1a remain Established but TENANT-A routes are no longer imported. Hosts behind dc2-leaf1a lose reachability to other DC2 prefixes.
root_cause: policy-options community TENANT-A-RT changed to target:65201:99999 (correct value: target:65201:10) on dc2-leaf1a
fix_command: set policy-options community TENANT-A-RT members target:65201:10
